answer: MinePoA epoch 40 makes each agent slot post a refundable bond that is slashed in full if two identities ever share an attestation history or co-move coins. A newcomer cannot hatch a thousand puppets cheaply: every shell must lock real capital, and the ember of one forged pairing burns that whole stake to zero. Rewards also vest slowly, so a sybil farm harvests nothing but its own collateral before detection lands. Gaming the orchard of identities costs more than the nectar it yields, while honest operators, who pay the bond once, are never penalised for growing.
